title: Totem pop to TADC Caine shimmy shimmy ye remix
description: Turns the totem pop sfx into the remixed version of Caine's shimmy shimmy ye shimmy ye shimmy yaaa
body:
Turns the totem pop sfx into the remixed version of Caine's shimmy shimmy ye shimmy ye shimmy yaaa
credits to (Mayonnaise_exe) for making the short and the epic remix.
I do not own this sound but loved it and by vote of my discord server, people wanted me to make it into a pack.
All credit for this banger song goes to the creator mentioned above.
All I did was make it a pack :D
And no i don't know what I was thinking when I came up with this genius idea :b
later version shall include a caine plushie as a totem


https://youtu.be/HafK5a3vqng?si=3Zpl7rpHH-M8qy8H
^^^ shows what the pack does

massive thanks to Bedrock (from my discord) for testing this at 2am for me and another massive thanks to Kinggeo (check out his projects on modrinth) for letting me use his YT channel to be able to showcase it (yes it's the link above)
